purpose: Determine whether qualified F-MR21 restart and F-MR22 parallel-v1 runtime work can be admitted onto the current F-CI24 canonical source without importing stale runtime postimages.

F_MR21.blob_identity_result: The four generic contracts used by the restart composition are byte-identical between the qualified F-MR21 source and F-CI24 canonical.
F_MR21.serialized_backend_note: The complete serialized backend blob has advanced on canonical, but the fmr_b110_physical_state_t and fmr_b110_temporal_indicator_state_t declarations consumed by the restart type contract remain structurally unchanged in the inspected source.
F_MR21.admission_rule: Do not inherit F-MQ27 as proof of the F-CI24 composition. Recompose the two runtime restart sources on the current canonical base and execute a fresh canonical-source-bound restart matrix including malformed-state, wrong-family, atomicity, continuation identity and mass gates.

F_MR22.blocking_interface_change: The qualified parallel worker pool calls public fmr_execute_serialized_physical_column. Current F-CI24 serialized runtime does not export that seam and instead contains the later accepted-commit-receipt API.
F_MR22.forbidden_shortcut: Do not copy the old serialized runtime postimage from F-MR22 or F-MR20R onto canonical. That would replace the newer receipt-aware canonical runtime and regress an already admitted contract.
F_MR22.required_next_step: Create a fresh current-canonical runtime composition that exposes a worker-safe one-column execution seam while preserving the accepted-commit-receipt public API and semantics, then independently requalify the complete restricted parallel-v1 matrix and canonical publication ordering.

F_MR20R_crosscheck.reason: F-MR20R is also F-CI18-lineage work. Its production remediation changes both mod_fmr_serialized_multiswap_runtime and mod_fmr_parallel_worker_pool, and its serialized runtime exposes the pre-receipt API. It therefore cannot serve as the current F-CI24 worker-seam composition.

admission_order: First, recompose and requalify F-MR21 restart against the current canonical runtime independently of parallel-v1.
Separately, repair the parallel worker execution seam against the receipt-aware canonical serialized runtime.
Only after each current-source-bound gate passes may a canonical promotion workunit be considered.
